import html # Predefined HTML template for blog posts. # The placeholders {title} and {body} will be replaced by the sanitized values. BLOG_FORMAT = """ {title}

{title}

{body}
""" def render_article_page(headline: str, content: str) -> str: """ Formats a blog post for safe display on a webpage. Parameters ---------- headline : str The title of the blog post. content : str The full text content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A string containing the sanitized and HTML‑formatted blog post. Raises ------ ValueError If either headline or content is not a string. """ if not isinstance(headline, str) or not isinstance(content, str): raise ValueError("Both headline and content must be strings") # Sanitize inputs to avoid XSS or HTML injection. safe_headline = html.escape(headline, quote=True) # Preserve line breaks by converting them to
tags after escaping. safe_content = html.escape(content, quote=True).replace('\n', '
\n') # Populate the template. rendered = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_headline, body=safe_content) return rendered
